test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question below. Counting should be done from left to right only.

(Note: All numbers are single digits only.)

 

(Left) 5 ^ * # 0 2 4 @ % 9 $ % 3 > @ 7 & * (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, then which of the following will be the sixth from the left?
solution:
Given: (Left) 5 ^ * # 0 2 4 @ % 9 $ % 3 > @ 7 & * (Right)

Now, 

Numbers are dropped from the series, then which of the following will be the sixth from the left.

So, Needed pattern is: ^, *, #, @, %, $, %, >, @, &, *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28052afd55fa9f29f66d9b4a40bf160c98094b965b0268e0a7e01cbd03333481.png] 

Thus, **$** will be the sixth from the left.

Hence, the correct answer is* 'Option 4'.*
